title: Agent burns 63 hours of tokens on a task with no ceiling
system: Single autonomous agent in a production pipeline
blast_radius: Reported USD 4,200 in model spend over 63 hours, against an estimated USD 50 had a ceiling been in place.
summary: A published postmortem tracks an agent's spend curve hour by hour: roughly forty dollars in the first hour, a few hundred by the fourth, four figures by hour twelve, and over four thousand by hour sixty-three. Nothing in the run was individually anomalous, which is why nothing alerted. The failure mode is not a bad step but the absence of any component holding the cumulative view — the same shape as the multi-agent loop, at single-agent scale.
containment: Manual intervention after the spend was noticed.

sources.title: The Agent That Burned $4,200 in 63 Hours: A Production AI Postmortem

scenario.description: A single agent retries without convergence, billing tokens on every attempt.
